name: MessageScroller
description: The scrolling region of a conversation. It follows new messages while the reader is at the bottom, stays put when the reader has scrolled up (with a Jump to latest button), and keeps the place when older messages are added at the top.

children.description: The messages, in order, oldest first.

unreadCount.description: How many new messages arrived while the reader was scrolled up. Shown on the Jump to latest button.

onReachTop.description: Called when the reader scrolls to the top, so older messages can be loaded. The scroll position is kept when they are added.

isLoadingOlder.description: Older messages are being loaded. Shows a status line at the top and pauses onReachTop.

threshold.description: How many pixels from the bottom still count as being at the bottom.

onAtBottomChange.description: Called when the reader moves away from the bottom or back to it. Use it to count and clear unread messages.

onJumpToLatest.description: Called after the reader presses Jump to latest, e.g. to clear the unread count.

keyboard: Tab moves to the region, then Arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End scroll it
Tab then reaches the Jump to latest button; Enter or Space scrolls to the newest message
requirements: The region has role log, aria-live polite and an accessible name from label
The region is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it
New messages are announced politely; the reader is never moved if they scrolled up
Smooth scrolling is turned off when the person prefers reduced motion
The Jump to latest button names the unread count
screenReader: The region is announced as a log with its label
New messages are read after the current speech
The button is announced as, for example, Jump to latest, 3 new messages

use_when: A conversation or activity feed that grows at the bottom
A chat where older messages load at the top
avoid_when: A full chat with a message box: use Chat
A static list that does not grow: use ScrollArea
anti_patterns: Forcing the reader to the bottom when they scrolled up on purpose
Giving the region no height, so it never scrolls
Streaming tokens into a polite live region without a quiet period
